exceptions.rationale: Debian classifies the Trixie issue as minor/no-DSA and has no Trixie fix. The reviewed v0.40.0 Linux AMD64 Registry Render local reproduction is exact rehearsal run 38015071330 at source 21738c8205c14a385b438f5fc542823044a2ade7, built on the pinned distroless cc-debian13 nonroot base sha256:e792ab3d241a468a4fd7519ddbbebe66b49b5f365771716ea688ad40b6c6f1c2. The pinned base and the reviewed loader, libc, libm and libpthread bytes are unchanged from the v0.39.0 review; this renewal reviews the changed application layer and executable bytes. Its executable imports none of the deprecated resolver-printing interfaces, including ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, ns_sprintrrf, ns_sprintrr and fp_nquery. The exposure report has no review-required dynamic lookup. Ordinary resolver initialization does not enter the vulnerable TSIG diagnostic-printing path. A candidate must retain the complete ordered reference rootfs layers, the production OCI process contract, and the Syft-bound reviewed executable, loader, libc, libm and libpthread file digests. Reviewed on 2026-10-10; Debian still records this Trixie version as vulnerable and fixes only forky and sid.

Debian Trixie gcc-14 14.2.0-19 remains vulnerable with no fixed Trixie package; Debian records sid 14.4.0-3 as fixed. The image's Trixie finding still has no fix in its Grype report. The reviewed v0.40.0 Linux AMD64 Registry Render local reproduction is exact rehearsal run 38015071330 at source 21738c8205c14a385b438f5fc542823044a2ade7, built on the pinned distroless cc-debian13 nonroot base sha256:e792ab3d241a468a4fd7519ddbbebe66b49b5f365771716ea688ad40b6c6f1c2. gcc-14-base 14.2.0-19 remains in the same unchanged base layer. The upstream fix for GCC PR127656 changes only the libstdc++ policy-based data structures binary_heap header, so the vulnerable code is template code that exists only in a C++ program that instantiates a __gnu_pbds binary heap; the image's libstdc++.so.6, libgcc_s.so.1 and libgomp.so.1 contain no __gnu_pbds or binary_heap names, and gcc-14-base installs only documentation. Its executable links none of libstdc++, libgcc_s or libgomp, and its bytes contain neither C++ type information nor __gnu_pbds names. The exposure report has no review-required dynamic lookup. No C++ __gnu_pbds binary heap is reachable from the image's code. A candidate must retain the complete ordered reference rootfs layers, the production OCI process contract, and the Syft-bound reviewed executable, loader, libc, libm and libpthread file digests. Reviewed on 2026-10-10; Debian still lists no fixed gcc-14 package for Trixie; sid 14.4.0-3 is fixed.

Debian Trixie gcc-14 14.2.0-19 remains vulnerable with no fixed Trixie package; Debian records sid 14.4.0-3 as fixed. The image's Trixie finding still has no fix in its Grype report. The reviewed v0.40.0 Linux AMD64 Registry Render local reproduction is exact rehearsal run 38015071330 at source 21738c8205c14a385b438f5fc542823044a2ade7, built on the pinned distroless cc-debian13 nonroot base sha256:e792ab3d241a468a4fd7519ddbbebe66b49b5f365771716ea688ad40b6c6f1c2. gcc-14-base 14.2.0-19 remains in the same unchanged base layer. The upstream fix, GCC commit 59d235ffa5a69231eb42e5290d52dc8c90d28b7a, changes only libstdc++'s aligned operator new in libsupc++/new_opa.cc so that rounding the requested size up to the alignment detects size_t overflow; upstream states that the posix_memalign implementation does not do that rounding and is not affected. The image's libstdc++.so.6 defines the aligned operator new functions over posix_memalign, passing the requested size unrounded, and imports neither aligned_alloc nor memalign; libgcc_s.so.1 and libgomp.so.1 define no aligned operator new, and gcc-14-base installs only documentation. No ELF file in the image links libstdc++ or libgomp, and only libstdc++ itself links libgcc_s. Its executable links none of libstdc++, libgcc_s or libgomp, imports no C++ symbol, and its bytes contain neither C++ type information nor operator new names. The exposure report has no review-required dynamic lookup. No aligned C++ operator new is reachable from the image's code. A candidate must retain the complete ordered reference rootfs layers, the production OCI process contract, and the Syft-bound reviewed executable, loader, libc, libm and libpthread file digests. Reviewed on 2026-10-10; Debian still lists no fixed gcc-14 package for Trixie; sid 14.4.0-3 is fixed.
